verdict.line: Buy. A 3-bed here at about $2,680 psf is at or below what the closest competitors' 3-bed-size resales support (about $3,000 psf as a new launch). 3-bed and 4-bed are the most wanted sizes in this mixed own-stay and rental area.
reasons: The closest competitors (Mayfair Modern, Mayfair Gardens, Daintree Residence, The Hillford, Verdale) work out to about $3,000 psf as a brand-new launch, after adding 5% where they were not built under the harmonised floor-area rules, a 34% new-launch premium (what launches selling now in the OCR charge over their closest resale, 12 launches).

Mayfair Modern (661 m away, 171 homes, completed 2022): its 3-bed-size resales (about 850 to 1,150 sq ft) averaged $2,295 psf over the last 12 months (5 resales), against a median $2,230 psf for all sizes. compsNote: 5 of the 5 competitors are within 1 km. Near-twins come first: up to two condos within 1.5 km with a similar number of homes (half to double) completed in 2016 or later. Then every suitable condo within 1 km (same tenure, completed 2011 or later first), widening to 2 km and 3 km only if fewer than 3; executive condos are left out. Resale prices are URA medians for the last 6 months where there were at least 5 resales, otherwise the last 12 months. Condos launched before June 2023 measured their areas under the old rules (including air-con ledges), so their psf is raised 5% to compare like for like.
priceDecide: Like for like by size: for each unit type we take each resale competitor's average psf for units within about 15% of that size (last 6 months, or 12 or 24 if too few). Each is raised by the 34% new-launch premium that launches selling now in the OCR carry over their closest resale (12 launches). Buy at or below = the average of the competitors' new-launch equivalents for that size; walk away above = 5% more. 2-bed: buy at or below $2,650, walk away above $2,780, this project about $2,828 psf; 3-bed: buy at or below $3,000, walk away above $3,150, this project about $2,676 psf; 4-bed: buy at or below $3,020, walk away above $3,170, this project about $2,555 psf. This project's price by unit type follows the developer's launch 'from' prices.  The developer breaks even at about $2,280 psf (EdgeProp's method); launches since 2023 priced on average 27% above break-even, which points to about $2,900 psf.

exit.note: How we test each buyer group, in today's money (prices, HDB values and incomes tend to rise together): the unit at today's current average price; a 25% down payment plus Buyer's Stamp Duty; HDB upgraders put their flat's sale proceeds in first (median resale price, minus an illustrative $150,000 loan). The group can buy if that capital covers the down payment and stamp duty; the income the remaining 30-year loan needs (tested at 4% under the 55% TDSR) is shown against SingStat's 2025 averages by home type, excluding employer CPF (4-room $11,097, 5-room and executive $13,887, condo $22,006). HDB resale prices rose 4.2% a year over the past 10 years, so upgraders' capital usually grows too. Singaporean HDB owners who buy before selling pay 20% Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty upfront and get it back only if they sell the flat within 6 months (IRAS).

fplans.note: Main layout per bedroom type (most units where counts are published), redrawn from the developers' plans in the Stacked Homes directory. Score out of 10, same rules for every plan: start at 4; +1 regular shape, dumbbell, kitchen that can be closed off, kitchen or yard window, AC ledge and planter under 5%, store or shelter or utility room; −1 long corridor, ledge and planter 10% or more, balcony over 12%. Efficiency = the share of the area not taken by AC ledges, planters, bay windows and corridors. Plans under the 2023 rules exclude AC ledges from the strata area, so their sq ft is all usable.
